text.text_excerpt: Homedale Inn is an old school dive bar. After reading Shannon and Harry's reviews I bookmarked this bar. While it took me almost a year to finally visit, I am glad I did. This doesn't seem like the kind of place one would normally find in this area. The Bulldog and Parlay's are close by, but I never could get into the atmosphere of those places. Homedale Inn is much more relaxed and less pretentious. In fact, it is all around better than the other bars nearby. My crew and I came by one night and despite the fact that none of us had ever been there, we were all greeted as regulars. The real regulars were surprisingly accepting of our somewhat rowdy group. The beer selection was decent, and...

WOW I can't believe no one has ever reviewed the Homedale Inn! Well I used to live right down the street and this was one of our favorite neighborhood spots when we didn't feel like venturing out much. This place has been around forever! (since 1937 to be exact). I am not a beer person but they carry lots of beers. Each night of the week they host different events (darts, open mic, comedy, trivia and the famous New Orleans classic "steak night"). It's a perfectly respectable neighborhood joint bar for you to hang out at.

What an interesting bar. Total locals dive, tucked into the Navarre neighborhood (often confused for Lakeview). It's the kind of place that everyone knows everyone's name, but none of them recognize faces because it's so dark and likely everyone's so drunk! They have some high tables and the bar, dart board and some tiny TV's. They give away free crockpot food occasionally and they do a mean trivia night. There's an awesome juke box inside too. The beers are cheap and mostly everyone sits outside and smokes and uses the inside to grab their drinks. Plenty of street parking!
